_comment: Packages that are DELIBERATELY not on the npm registry. Being listed here downgrades
a 404 from a hard failure to a reported exception. It does NOT make it fine.
This list may only SHRINK. An unlisted package that 404s fails the gate, and a listed
package that has since been published ALSO fails, so it cannot become a place absent
Why eslint-config and tsconfig are here: the publish token can push to an EXISTING
package but cannot CREATE one — a 404 on PUT means authenticated-but-unauthorised.
Creating them needs a token with create rights, or an npm Trusted Publisher configured
per package. Both are operator actions. They also reach zero consumers (B-19), so
whether they should exist at all is an open question, not a foregone one.
Why workflow-canvas is here: it is BRAND NEW (0.1.0, 2026-09-01) and has never been
published, so a 404 is the only answer the registry can give until its first publish
from main. It hits the same create-rights wall as the two above — that is an operator
action, not something this PR can do. This entry is the ONLY one expected to leave:
the moment @bsuite/workflow-canvas exists on the registry the gate FAILS on a stale
acknowledgement, which is what forces it out rather than letting it settle here.
